title: tokenzero.ledger.v2 LedgerRecord
description: Append-only accounting record for one served TokenZero response. v2 is a strict superset of v1: it adds the recovery_costs block carrying the RATC identity (ratc = visible + expand + rho_fail*retries + lambda_fail*fails). Telemetry-only: records never carry payload bytes. v1 lines remain readable via serde defaults (see crates/tokenzero-engine/src/ledger.rs module docs for the migration note).

prevented_tokens.description: Existing dedup/diff visible savings only; never a prevented-read estimate.

visible_tokens.description: Mirrors token_mass.visible_tokens so ratc is self-contained.

expand_tokens.description: Billed tokens spent on ref expansion (telemetry pointer /expand/visible_tokens).

rho_fail.description: Weight per retry in the RATC identity.

lambda_fail.description: Weight per failure in the RATC identity.

task_success.description: Per-task outcome; null = unknown (E1.2 per-task grouping out of scope).

anchor_recall_ok.description: Whether anchor recall succeeded for the task; null = unknown.

ratc.description: Recovery-adjusted token cost: visible_tokens + expand_tokens + rho_fail*retry_count + lambda_fail*fail_count. Stored so auditors read one field; must equal the identity computed from this block's own fields.
